scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @typemind/api" "npm run dev -w @typemind/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @typemind/shared && npm run build -w @typemind/api && npm run build -w @typemind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @typemind/shared && npm run typecheck -w @typemind/api && npm run typecheck -w @typemind/web
